question: Estimate the LGBTQ+ consumer market size in Indian metros.
idealClarificationQuestions: Out / openly LGBTQ+ adults in metros who are addressable by brands? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Population × LGBTQ+ share × out / addressable share × disposable income.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, out/openly identified (post-Section 377 decriminalization + younger generations): ~30% = ~2M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average annual consumer disposable spend: ~₹4-6 lakh per individual.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: But LGBTQ+-targeted brand spend (Pride campaigns, allyship marketing) is much smaller: ~₹500-1,000 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, in disposable income bracket (urban metro skews affluent)

calculationFlow: LGBTQ+ share of population (research estimates): ~7-10% = 6-8M individuals.
Of these, out/openly identified (post-Section 377 decriminalization + younger generations): ~30% = ~2M.
Of these, in disposable income bracket (urban metro skews affluent): ~70% = ~1.4M.
Average annual consumer disposable spend: ~₹4-6 lakh per individual.
Total addressable LGBTQ+ market (metro, out): ~1.4M × ₹5L = ₹70,000 Cr in addressable consumer wallet.
But LGBTQ+-targeted brand spend (Pride campaigns, allyship marketing) is much smaller: ~₹500-1,000 Cr.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: But LGBTQ+-targeted brand spend (Pride campaigns, allyship marketing) is much smaller: ~₹500-1,000 Cr.
